SELECT USER_CD , USER_NM , ISNULL(CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,1), (AMOUNT2/AMOUNT1)*100), 0) AS AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM dbo.T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SALES_YM = #yyyymm#) AS AMOUNT1 , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM dbo.T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE SALES_GUBUN = #sales_base# AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SALES_YM = #yyyymm#) AS AMOUNT2 FROM T_USER A WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND DEPT_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup#)
AND MBO_YN = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY USER_CD, DEPT_CD ) Z ORDER BY AMOUNT DESC

AND DEPT_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup#)
AND MBO_YN = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY USER_CD, DEPT_CD ) Z ORDER BY AMOUNT DESC
